anchor.what: Locked identity of casting voice 2, "gentle nursery teacher". Reproduced bit-for-bit-equivalent from the casting recipe.
anchor.transcript: Once upon a time, in a little house by the park, there lived a small rabbit who loved to count the stars. One, two, three... and then she gave a big, sleepy yawn.

recipe.seeding: torch.manual_seed(200); np.random.seed(200) immediately before the batch call
recipe.instruct: A gentle British nursery teacher in her late twenties with a soft Southern English accent. Clear, kind and encouraging, lightly bright but not bubbly, unhurried and even, articulating each word softly. British English female narrator reading a picture book aloud to a small child. She reads slowly, at a relaxed bedtime-story pace, letting each phrase breathe with soft pauses at the commas. Gentle and calm throughout, never shouty, never dramatic, no sudden changes in volume or pitch.
recipe.text: Once upon a time, in a little house by the park, there lived a small rabbit who loved to count the stars. One, two, three... and then she gave a big, sleepy yawn.
